body.message:
Hello Ms. Darina,

Thank you for your message, and please accept our sincere apologies for the inconvenience caused.

Regarding the construction outside the building, unfortunately this is beyond our control, and we are unable to make any changes regarding this matter. However, we completely understand your concern.

As for the cleanliness issue and the door lock concern, please allow us some time to coordinate with our team. We will update you shortly and arrange for someone to visit and check the apartment for you.

Thank you for your understanding.
